messages:
marc: Draft announce + benchmark deck uploaded. Need eng + docs + sales signoff on changelog lines, canary timing, and UTMs before we lock embargo. Can we confirm here? :eyes:
liz: Paste the exact changelog excerpt and the canary windows. Also confirm if we should call out Dedicated behavior separately.
eden: Proposed changelog snippet: "Improved inference routing with a staged canary rollout and an automatic lightweight-fallback to preserve latency under load." Full details in staging docs: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/releases/apr-announce-draft
eden: Canary plan (eng): start 04/10 00:00 UTC at 10% traffic to variant `v4-quant-lite`, hold 6h, ramp to 50% 04/11 08:00 UTC, full 04/12 02:00 UTC if green. Rollback target: `v3-stable`. Policy id: `release-2026-04-canary`
liz: Webinar planned Wed 04/10 16:00 PT. Registration UTMs: utm_campaign=apr_release_2026&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email. For paid ads add utm_term=paid and set lead_priority=high.
sales-ops: SFDC queue mapping ok: queue=inbound_ml_products; add tags product=AprRelease26. We will prioritize leads where utm_term=paid. Need final UTMs before we push the form.
ops-bot: Canary created: name=release-2026-04-canary, variant=v4-quant-lite, initial_traffic=10%, monitor_url=/ops/releases/release-2026-04
marc: Marketing needs final go/no-go by EOD so embargo can lift Thu morning. Please react with :thumbsup: when your lane is green.
eden: :thumbsup: Eng confirmed. Will attach final changelog URL when docs publish.
liz: :thumbsup: Docs will publish today at 18:00 PT and I'll paste the canonical /docs link here.
sales-ops: :thumbsup: SFDC and UTMs queued once final values posted.
marc: Thanks all ":rocket:"
